sentences.text: I like reading ___ swimming.

blanks.hint: Use this to connect two similar ideas (two likes).

sentences.explanation: We use 'and' to connect two things we like.

sentences.text: I don’t like shopping ___ playing football.

blanks.hint: Use this to connect two similar ideas in a negative sentence (two dislikes).

sentences.explanation: We use 'or' to connect two things we don't like in a negative sentence.

sentences.text: He likes watching TV, ___ he doesn’t like doing homework.

blanks.hint: Use this to connect a positive idea and a negative idea.

sentences.explanation: We use 'but' to show a contrast between something we like and something we don't like.

sentences.text: She likes riding her bike ___ playing football.
sentences.explanation: We use 'and' to connect two things we like.

activities.title: Combine Your Ideas
activities.instruction: Combine the simple sentences into one sentence using 'and', 'or', or 'but'.
